options.reason: The table is a bank telemarketing dataset evidently assembled to predict whether a client subscribes to a term deposit (y, two observed values), so binary classification on y with the workflow default metric is the defensible study; call duration is only known after the call ends and trivially encodes the outcome, so it is a leakage suspect. Day and month are campaign timing attributes of a static-entity cross-section, not consecutive periods of a series, so no time columns are declared.
options.title: binary
